questions.question: What did Eliphaz say about the one whom God reproves?
What did Eliphaz urge Job to do?
options: Flee far from his home and friends
Curse God and be done with life
Seek God and commit his cause to him
Give up and wait quietly for death
questions.answer: Seek God and commit his cause to him

questions.question: Eliphaz said God wounds, but his hands also heal.
